//: TV Head mapping. Lives in the repo so it is version controlled; tools/push-media.ps1 pushes it to the tablet.
//keys: PROVISIONAL key names below. Press each key on the real keypad with showKeyDebug on, read the name off the screen, and swap these out.
//combos: Modifiers work: Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta. e.g. Ctrl+Shift+A. A chord matches only when exactly those keys are held, so A and Ctrl+A are different bindings.
//default: The face shown on launch. Change this to whichever should be the resting face.
//media: A video loops forever; a .jpg is held as a still. Whatever is pressed stays until the next key.
